summary: Drive base URL from TCX_FQDN and derive the OAuth token URL from the base host; removed the hardcoded instance FQDN.
reason: The spec baked one instance's absolute server/token URL as the only default, making the CLI instance-locked and leaking the FQDN; every 3CX deployment has its own FQDN.
validated_outcome: TCX_FQDN=acme.3cx.com.au derives https://acme.3cx.com.au/xapi/v1 and token URL; unset errors with a clear 'set TCX_FQDN' message.
